humanScope: Implement the reviewed location, manual-menu and repeated-Compare fixes. Human chose local testing without phone.

catalog: Explicit MANUAL/PUBLIC origins and source-specific selection; selected area no longer overrides a manual menu.
Public directory refresh merges independent origins and cannot replace the selected manual menu.
Manual product selection no longer resolves through a same-name public menu.
Session completion reports observed restaurant/meal counts, including names-only and zero-data outcomes.
location: Foreground-only explicit current-location request via Android LocationManager and Arabic Geocoder; no background location permission or retained coordinates.
Canonical provider city/district links; fuzzy Arabic suggestions never silently select a different place.
Bounded public-name cache, cancellation, permission-denial fallback and explicit retry; verified saved area remains available when name refresh fails.
basket: Current HS and Keeta 3.13.203 main Compare now share complete known-cart reconciliation for one/two plain lines.
App-private AtomicFile journal commits hashed pending actions before Add or basket-quantity dispatch.
Restart, cancellation and failed dispatch do not erase unresolved mutations; complete matching rows are required to recover.
A previously known nonempty cart with a missing footer is not treated as a new empty cart.
Single-item HungerStation legacy mutation loop removed; handoffs use read-only complete-row path.

newCases: Manual menu absent from selected public area remains visible/selectable.
Same-name public menu cannot intercept a saved manual product.
Misspelled city/district input selects canonical suggestions through actual Compose UI.
Pending action survives actual AtomicFile reopen; corrupt storage fails closed.
Denied location permission fails before GPS access and offers manual selection.

remaining: No live GPS/geocoder verification on Honor; approximate location may not meet the current 500m accuracy bound.
No fresh provider repeated-Compare/empty-both/handoff journey on this changed APK; emulator fixtures are not that proof.
First-ever empty-menu inference still depends on existing recorded provider layouts; the new journal closes restart/known-cart ambiguity, not a universal positive-empty reader.
If a previously known cart was genuinely emptied outside Octopus, the missing-footer guard deliberately blocks a new first Add until a positive empty-cart recovery is implemented/verified.
City/district index requests from this computer returned 403; live Android access and canonical GPS mapping remain unverified.
Foreign-cart replacement, arbitrary options/modifiers/scrolling baskets and true address/branch equivalence retain prior gaps.

publication.note: Release workflow still pins 1.3.10; do not push this auto-publishing branch casually.
